snippet.title: Trigonometric Equations - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Trigonometric Equations is a strict side-scrolling rhythm game. Solve the trigonometric equations to fly through fleeting points and curves perfectly!

Steam: store.steampowered.com/app/4035290/Trigonometric_Equations/
Wishlist on Steam Now!

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Trigonometric Equations is a strict side-scrolling rhythm game.
Move your mouse to adjust the graph.
The triangle will move forwards while following the graph.
Press when the triangle meets the points.
Press and hold while the triangle passes through the curves.
But, don't press nor hold if the triangle is passing through dashed line.
If the point has a hole inside it, don't press and let the triangle just pass through.

Fly up, down, left, or right and press in a perfect beat to prevent the triangle from crashing!

Features
- Multiple unique original soundtracks
- Beautiful and colorful levels to play
- Very detailed level editor to make your own creative level
- Practice mode for when you get stuck
- Automatic timing calibration for perfect sync between sounds and visuals
- Get better at solving trigonometric equations (no)
